title: Duality Gaps in Partially Nonconvex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2503.02464v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study duality gaps in separable optimization problems that contain both convex and nonconvex functions. Classical bounds on the duality gap of such partially nonconvex problems depend solely on the nonconvex functions. As a result, a problem with many convex functions has no tighter bound than one with none at all. To understand the impact of convex functions on the duality gap beyond the worst case, we analyze a probabilistic setting in which the convex hulls of the functions' epigraphs are independent and identically distributed. Using the Shapley-Folkman lemma, we derive lower bounds on the distribution of the duality gap that depend on both the number of convex and nonconvex functions. These bounds show that zero or small duality gaps become increasingly likely as convex functions outnumber nonconvex ones. translated_title: 部分非凸优化中的对偶间隙
translated_abstract: 我们研究了同时包含凸函数和非凸函数的可分离优化问题中的对偶间隙。经典的对偶间隙界仅依赖于非凸函数，因此，包含许多凸函数的问题并不比完全没有凸函数的问题具有更紧的界。为了理解凸函数在对偶间隙上的影响（超越最坏情况），我们分析了一个概率设置，其中函数上图的凸包是独立同分布的。利用Shapley-Folkman引理，我们推导出对偶间隙分布的下界，这些下界同时依赖于凸函数和非凸函数的数量。这些界表明，随着凸函数数量超过非凸函数，零或小的对偶间隙变得越来越可能。这样，它们支持了“近似凸”问题往往比“纯非凸”问题具有更小对偶间隙的直觉。
tldr: 本文通过概率分析表明，在部分非凸优化中，当凸函数数量增多时，对偶间隙趋于零或变小的概率增大，从而为“近似凸”问题具有更小对偶间隙提供了理论支持。
en_tdlr: This paper shows probabilistically that in partially nonconvex optimization, as convex functions outnumber nonconvex ones, the duality gap tends to be zero or small with higher probability, supporting the intuition that "nearly convex" problems have smaller duality gaps.
